title: GitHub AI Agent Leaks Your Private Repos With Just One Word
description:
Your GitHub agent can leak your private repos on its own, no password no hack needed 🔥

Researchers at Noma Labs found a hole in GitHub Agentic Workflows. You just walk into an orgs public repo, open a normal Issue with the right text, and the agent goes and post contents of private repos right there in the comments. Wild.

The scariest part? One single word, "Additionally", dropped in the right spot completely shut off the models defenses 😅 the attack vector isnt code anymore its plain text. Any ticket comment or doc can basically hijack your agent ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
